options.name: access
options.description: The access mode for this datasource.

options.name: additional_json_data
options.description: Defined data is used for datasource jsonData Data may be overridden by specifically defined parameters (like zabbix_user)

options.name: additional_secure_json_data
options.description: Defined data is used for datasource secureJsonData Data may be overridden by specifically defined parameters (like tls_client_cert) Stored as secure data, see C(enforce_secure_data) and notes!

options.name: alertmanager_handle_grafana_alerts
options.description: Whether Grafana should send alerts to this alertmanager.

options.name: alertmanager_implementation
options.description: The implementation to set for the alertmanager datasource type.

options.name: aws_access_key
options.description: AWS access key for CloudWatch datasource type when C(aws_auth_type) is C(keys) Stored as secure data, see C(enforce_secure_data) and notes!

options.name: aws_assume_role_arn
options.description: AWS IAM role arn to assume for CloudWatch datasource type when C(aws_auth_type) is C(arn)

options.name: aws_auth_type
options.description: Type for AWS authentication for CloudWatch datasource type (authType of grafana api)

options.name: aws_credentials_profile
options.description: Profile for AWS credentials for CloudWatch datasource type when C(aws_auth_type) is C(credentials)

options.name: aws_custom_metrics_namespaces
options.description: Namespaces of Custom Metrics for CloudWatch datasource type

options.name: aws_default_region
options.description: AWS default region for CloudWatch datasource type

options.name: aws_secret_key
options.description: AWS secret key for CloudWatch datasource type when C(aws_auth_type) is C(keys) Stored as secure data, see C(enforce_secure_data) and notes!

options.name: azure_client
options.description: The application/client ID for the Azure AD app registration to use for authentication.

options.name: azure_cloud
options.description: The national cloud for your Azure account

options.name: azure_secret
options.description: The application client secret for the Azure AD app registration to use for auth

options.name: azure_tenant
options.description: The directory/tenant ID for the Azure AD app registration to use for authentication

options.name: basic_auth_password
options.description: The datasource basic auth password, when C(basic auth) is C(true). Stored as secure data, see C(enforce_secure_data) and notes!

options.name: basic_auth_user
options.description: The datasource basic auth user. Setting this option with basic_auth_password will enable basic auth.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: PEM formatted certificate chain file to be used for SSL client authentication. This file can also include the key as well, and if the key is included, I(client_key) is not required

options.name: client_key
options.description: PEM formatted file that contains your private key to be used for SSL client authentication. If I(client_cert) contains both the certificate and key, this option is not required.

options.name: database
options.description: Name of the database for the datasource. This options is required when the C(ds_type) is C(influxdb), C(elasticsearch) (index name), C(mysql) or C(postgres).

options.name: ds_type
options.description: The type of the datasource. Required when C(state=present).

options.name: ds_url
options.description: The URL of the datasource. Required when C(state=present).

options.name: enforce_secure_data
options.description: Secure data is not updated per default (see notes!) To update secure data you have to enable this option! Enabling this, the task will always report changed=True

options.name: es_version
options.description: Elasticsearch version (for C(ds_type = elasticsearch) only) Version 56 is for elasticsearch 5.6+ where you can specify the C(max_concurrent_shard_requests) option.

options.name: grafana_api_key
options.description: The Grafana API key. If set, C(url_username) and C(url_password) will be ignored.

options.name: interval
options.description: For elasticsearch C(ds_type), this is the index pattern used.

options.name: is_default
options.description: Make this datasource the default one.

options.name: max_concurrent_shard_requests
options.description: Starting with elasticsearch 5.6, you can specify the max concurrent shard per requests.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the datasource.

options.name: org_id
options.description: Grafana organization ID in which the datasource should be created. Not used when C(grafana_api_key) is set, because the C(grafana_api_key) only belongs to one organization. Mutually exclusive with C(org_name).

options.name: org_name
options.description: Grafana organization name in which the datasource should be created. Not used when C(grafana_api_key) is set, because the C(grafana_api_key) only belongs to one organization. Mutually exclusive with C(org_id).

options.name: password
options.description: The datasource password. Stored as secure data, see C(enforce_secure_data) and notes!

options.name: sslmode
options.description: SSL mode for C(postgres) datasource type.

options.name: state
options.description: Status of the datasource

options.name: time_field
options.description: Name of the time field in elasticsearch ds. For example C(@timestamp).

options.name: time_interval
options.description: Minimum group by interval for C(influxdb), C(elasticsearch) or C(prometheus) datasources. for example C(>10s).

options.name: tls_ca_cert
options.description: The TLS CA certificate for self signed certificates. Only used when C(tls_client_cert) and C(tls_client_key) are set. Stored as secure data, see C(enforce_secure_data) and notes!

options.name: tls_client_cert
options.description: The client TLS certificate. If C(tls_client_cert) and C(tls_client_key) are set, this will enable TLS authentication. Starts with ----- BEGIN CERTIFICATE ----- Stored as secure data, see C(enforce_secure_data) and notes!

options.name: tls_client_key
options.description: The client TLS private key Starts with ----- BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY ----- Stored as secure data, see C(enforce_secure_data) and notes!

options.name: tls_servername
options.description: A Servername is used to verify the hostname on the returned certificate

options.name: tls_skip_verify
options.description: Skip the TLS datasource certificate verification.

options.name: trends
options.description: Use trends or not for zabbix datasource type.

options.name: tsdb_resolution
options.description: The opentsdb time resolution.

options.name: tsdb_version
options.description: The opentsdb version. Use C(1) for <=2.1, C(2) for ==2.2, C(3) for ==2.3.

options.name: uid
options.description: The uid of the datasource.

options.name: url
options.description: The Grafana URL.

options.name: url_password
options.description: The Grafana password for API authentication.

options.name: url_username
options.description: The Grafana user for API authentication.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(false), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: user
options.description: The datasource login user for influxdb datasources.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(false) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: with_credentials
options.description: Whether credentials such as cookies or auth headers should be sent with cross-site requests.

options.name: zabbix_password
options.description: Password for Zabbix API

options.name: zabbix_user
options.description: User for Zabbix API
